papers.title: Minimal invasive posterior total hip arthroplasty: are 6 weeks of hip precautions really necessary?
papers.first_author_affiliation: Adult Reconstruction and Joint Replacement Division, Hospital for Special Surgery, 535 East 70th Street, New York, NY, 10021, USA

corresponding_authors.name: Tom Schmidt-Braekling
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Adult Reconstruction and Joint Replacement Division, Hospital for Special Surgery, 535 East 70th Street, New York, NY, 10021, USA

papers.venue: Archives of Orthopaedic and Trauma Surgery

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注术后预防措施，不涉及髋关节植入物生物力学或有限元分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify femoral stress shielding, micromotion, or provide any biomechanical modeling or implant design relevant to the hip implant direction.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究微创后路全髋置换术后6周预防措施是否必要
summary_zh.method: 纳入微创后路全髋置换患者，分为预防措施组与对照组比较
summary_zh.result: 术后6周预防措施可能不必要，但结论需进一步验证
summary_zh.validation: 临床对照研究，基于患者术后随访结果

summary_en.motivation: This study investigates whether a 6-week hip precaution protocol is necessary after minimally invasive posterior total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Patients undergoing minimally invasive posterior total hip arthroplasty were divided into groups with and without preoperative education on hip precautions.
summary_en.result: The study found no significant difference in dislocation rates between groups, suggesting that extended precautions may not be required.
summary_en.validation: Clinical validation through prospective comparison of patient outcomes at follow-up.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究维生素E共混对高交联超高分子量聚乙烯塑性变形机制的影响，未涉及股骨柄应力遮挡或微动分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on material-level deformation mechanisms of polyethylene acetabular liners, not on femoral stem stress shielding, micromotion, or bone-implant interface mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究维生素E共混对高交联UHMWPE塑性变形机制的影响
summary_zh.method: 通过力学测试和微观结构分析表征不同配方材料的变形行为
summary_zh.result: 维生素E共混改变了材料的屈服和硬化行为，影响塑性变形机制
summary_zh.validation: 力学测试验证材料性能差异

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of vitamin E blending on the plastic deformation mechanisms of highly crosslinked UHMWPE used in total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Mechanical testing and microstructural analysis were performed to characterize the deformation behavior of UHMWPE with different vitamin E concentrations.
summary_en.result: Vitamin E blending altered the yield and hardening behavior, influencing the plastic deformation mechanisms of the material.
summary_en.validation: Experimental mechanical testing validated the differences in material properties.

papers.title: Multi-physics and multi-scale benchmarking and uncertainty quantification within OECD/NEA framework

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文专注于核能领域的多物理场多尺度基准测试与不确定性量化，与生物力学植入物设计无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on nuclear reactor physics benchmarks, not on biomedical implant design, FEA surrogate modeling, or biomechanics constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 为核能领域多物理场多尺度模拟提供基准测试与不确定性量化框架。
summary_zh.method: 基于OECD/NEA框架，开发多物理场耦合基准测试案例并进行不确定性分析。
summary_zh.result: 建立了可用于验证核反应堆模拟的基准测试集。
summary_zh.validation: 通过国际基准测试案例进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: To establish a benchmarking and uncertainty quantification framework for multi-physics and multi-scale simulations in nuclear energy.
summary_en.method: Developed benchmark cases within the OECD/NEA framework, coupling multiple physics and performing uncertainty analysis.
summary_en.result: Provided a set of benchmarks for validating nuclear reactor simulations.
summary_en.validation: Validated through international benchmark cases with numerical comparisons.

papers.title: Integrated Uncertainty Quantification for Risk and Resource Management: A NASA Langley Perspective (Invited)
papers.abstract: Uncertainty management in the design process can improve both risk and resource management while building confidence in the design. This paper postulates how uncertainty could be managed in a program or project to the benefit of scarce resources. An assessment space is introduced to aid in the management of the design cycle progression through its stages of maturity. The importance of classification and integration of uncertainties is discussed with some examples provided.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文从项目管理角度讨论不确定性量化，未涉及代理模型或生物力学设计。
llm.why_not_core: No surrogate modeling, no FEA, no biomedical or implant design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 在设计中管理不确定性以优化资源和风险。
summary_zh.method: 提出评估空间框架，分类和集成不确定性。
summary_zh.result: 讨论了不确定性管理对设计成熟度的影响。
summary_zh.validation: 无具体验证，仅为概念性讨论。

summary_en.motivation: To improve risk and resource management in design by integrating uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: Proposes an assessment space framework for classifying and integrating uncertainties across design stages.
summary_en.result: Discusses how uncertainty management can build confidence and optimize resource allocation.
summary_en.validation: No validation; conceptual paper with examples.

papers.title: Uncertainty Quantification for the Actuation Power Requirements of a Hybrid Wing Body Configuration with Electrically Actuated Flight Control Surfaces

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究航空飞行器控制面的功率不确定性量化，与生物力学植入物设计无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on aerospace actuation power UQ, with no implant biomechanics, no FEA surrogate modeling, and no biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 量化混合翼身构型电驱动控制面的功率需求不确定性。
summary_zh.method: 采用不确定性量化方法分析飞行器控制面功率需求。
summary_zh.result: 获得了功率需求的不确定性分布。

summary_en.motivation: To quantify the uncertainty in actuation power requirements for a hybrid wing body aircraft with electrically actuated flight control surfaces.
summary_en.method: Uncertainty quantification methods are applied to analyze the power demand of flight control surfaces.
summary_en.result: The uncertainty distribution of actuation power requirements is obtained.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through simulation case studies.

papers.title: 'Uncertainty Quantification Study of Non-Equilibrium Viscous Shock-Layer'

summary_zh.method: 采用不确定性量化方法分析激波层流动

summary_en.motivation: To quantify uncertainties in non-equilibrium viscous shock-layer flows for aerospace applications.
summary_en.method: Uncertainty quantification techniques are applied to analyze the shock-layer flow field.
summary_en.result: The impact of uncertainties on shock-layer characteristics is assessed.
